articles.title: 4 Off Beat Detective TV Shows Better Than Lanterns, With a Combined 76 Episodes
articles.summary: The upcoming DC series "Lanterns" was conceived as a gritty detective show, a vision detailed by Peter Safran at the January 2023 DC slate presentation. This approach aims to distinguish it from typical superhero narratives, focusing on a "True Detective"-like tone. The show will feature two Green Lanterns investigating a dark mystery within the DC Universe, promising a fresh and intricate take on the iconic comic book property for its television adaptation.
